title: How is Fidel Castro connected to Patrick Star?
description:
Two presidents, a Star Wars legend and a Hollywood ceremony connect Fidel Castro to Patrick Star, through the voice of Patrick, Bill Fagerbakke.

Fidel Castro → Enrique Peña Nieto → Joe Biden → Mark Hamill → Bill Fagerbakke → Patrick Star

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
